name: Chandelure
notes: Painted design: near-black smoky metal arms, bars, discs and zig-zag trims with soft painted gradients and small painted white glints at bar ends; the glass head is a separate white island (Glass/Glass2 materials) and the flames are their own emissive materials.

So: dark lacquered iron: the painted grain only, very low; painted glints kept crisp; lower roughness and a slightly raised spec mask; glass head and flames untouched (crisp upscale only; Fire_dif/Fire_par are not in the pack data).

Body_par is BC1 (no alpha), so no metallic channel can be written: the metal read comes from roughness (R) and spec mask (B) only. The body shader 2613379960 carries no metal parameters (census: FresnelColor, innerColor, sssContrast), so a BC3/BC7 _par alone would very likely not make it metallic; that needs a material swap to a metal shader such as 1096415554 (reads paramsTexture.w, metal_coef). Not verifiable locally: the body shader's fragment code is not dumped. No normal sampler: in game only _dif and _par load.
